raw_html: [[Armor Mastery| Armor Mastery +3]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Armor Mastery| Armor Mastery +3]]:''' Passive: +3 [[Enhancement bonus]] to the [[Maximum dexterity bonus|Max Dex Bonus]] of your equipped [[Light armor|light]], [[Medium armor|medium]], or [[heavy armor]].
